findings.title: Button text is not HTML-escaped while Label text is
findings.message: Label text is passed through html.EscapeString because Cogent's Text widget parses markup. Button text is passed raw, both here and in syncRecord. Cogent Button labels are normally rendered through the same markup-aware Text child. A label such as "a < b" or "<b>" may then be mangled or interpreted as markup. This is inconsistent with the Label path.
findings.suggestion: Check how core.Button renders its text. If it parses markup, apply html.EscapeString(n.Text) in both mount and syncRecord. If it does not, document the difference and keep the Label escaping consistent with it.

finding.title: Compiled binary committed to the repository
finding.message: A compiled executable (drivers/cogent/workbench, mode 755) is committed to the repository. Binaries bloat history and can't be reviewed. They also go stale relative to the source, and can hide unreviewed code. check.sh already runs `go build ./cmd/workbench`, so the artifact can be regenerated.
finding.suggestion: Remove the binary from version control, add it to .gitignore, and build it in CI or locally with `go build ./cmd/workbench`.
